audience: real-estate agencies that keep their listings and CRM contacts in Tokko Broker

useCases.title: Review the published listings and their prices
useCases.text: List the agency's properties with their operation type and prices. Open one property to read its full details.

useCases.title: Check the units of a development
useCases.text: List the agency's developments. Open one development to see its details and units.

useCases.title: Follow up on the agency's CRM contacts
useCases.text: List the CRM contacts of the agency and open one to read its details. Use the data only for the agency's own follow-up.
